label: Staircase
blurb: A single wipe edge crosses the frame as a flight of stairs: the boundary holds level across each band and then steps up to the next one, so the incoming shot arrives behind a hard stepped diagonal. Set how many steps there are and how deep the tread is, from a shallow lean to a steep staircase, and which corner the flight climbs from. A sawtooth edge it is not: every step goes the same way, so the edge marches across in one direction.
